title: horizon --gates counts an answer as the recommendation when the recommendation is only a prefix of it
goal: horizon --gates counts an answer as the recommendation only when it equals it (a recommendation is stored as an option's exact text), so an operator who picks the option 'yes, with a cap' over the recommendation 'yes' is counted as departing. Review gap G6.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a, env=None: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env); sp=r("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","g").stdout.split()[2]; i=r("new","story","--sprint",sp,"--title","T","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; r("gate","add",i,"--kind","blocking","--question","Is the cap needed?","--option","yes","--option","yes, with a cap","--recommendation","yes"); r("answer",i,"g1","--option","2","--by","operator"); p=r("horizon","--gates","--sprint",sp); sys.exit("a prefix answer counted as the recommendation: "+p.stdout[-200:] if "recommendation taken 1 of 1" in p.stdout else 0)
